question: Right to life is guaranteed under ______ of the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 21.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 21** of the Constitution of India guarantees the fundamental right to life and personal liberty.
 
• This article states: **"No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law."**
 
• The scope of Article 21 has been expanded through various landmark judgments by the Supreme Court to include the right to a dignified life, health, and a clean environment.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the protection of individual rights and has become a cornerstone of personal freedoms in India.
 
• Article 21 underscores the importance of due process and legal protection in safeguarding an individual's life and liberty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitution of India**: Adopted on January 26, 1950, it serves as the supreme law of the land, establishing the framework for governance and protecting fundamental rights.
 
• **Related Articles**:
 
 
• **Article 14**: Guarantees the right to equality before the law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
 
• **Article 15**: Prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• **Article 16**: Provides for equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Interpretation**: The Supreme Court of India has interpreted Article 21 to include various rights such as the right to privacy, the right to live with dignity, and the right to a healthy environment.
 
• **Significant Cases**: Landmark cases like *Keshavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala* and *Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India* have played a crucial role in expanding the interpretation of Article 21.
 
• **Impact**: Article 21 serves as a vital protection against arbitrary state action and reinforces the commitment to human rights and personal liberty in India.
